rejection_evidence.location: User-provided Google Chrome and AdSense policy notices

findings.evidence: The supplied notices state that Chrome mobile and AdSense stopped ads for Better Ads Standards violations.
The current main branch keeps the AdSense loader out of the root layout and its component blocks mobile viewports, preventing the reviewed mobile experience from returning before approval.
The Coupang affiliate banner component and its layout import/render were removed, so neither the banner nor its measurement script can render.
Only the local repository was changed; no production deployment or cache purge was performed.
The notice gives the policy category but not the exact URL/creative list from the Ad Experience Report.

verification: npm run build completed successfully on 2026-08-17; Next.js generated 1,094 routes.
Static source assertions confirmed both delivery switches are false.
next_step: Deploy these changes, then use the Ad Experience Report on a mobile viewport to confirm no ads or ad overlays remain before submitting Google's review request.
